High level ask: please confirm your ramp expectations (steady-state GPU count by month 3 and month 6), procurement/PO cadence, and whether Allegro prefers term-level discounts or milestone-linked credits.

Quick framing from our side:
- Commitment units: we can price by committed GPU slots (1xA100 equiv) or by committed vGPU-hours.
- Pricing options: 12/24/36-month terms (larger discounts at longer terms).
- Ramp credits: we can offer milestone credits applied to the first invoice when you hit defined MAP milestones (PO issued, test-eval complete, production ramp).
- Burst policy: baseline committed pool with a short-term burst allowance (proposed 15% free burst for first 90 days), then priority queueing and overage billing. We can adjust burst percent for a higher commit.

Notes / next steps:
1) If you share a simple month-by-month forecast we’ll map it to slabs and show precise per-token and per-hour economics.
2) If procurement requires a single consolidated quote, Rishi can send a formal PDF quote and DocuSign link.
3) We’ll bake the MAP milestones into a simple SOW-like checklist so legal/procurement can sign off quickly.

Attaching: allegro_map_v1.xlsx (MAP draft).

Subject: Pricing options + MAP milestone credit mechanics

Chris — following up with concrete options so procurement has something to evaluate. See the three slabs below; I attached the formal quote (dedicated_quote_v3.pdf) that maps these to the forecast you sent.

Option A — Conservative commit (12 mo trial)
- Commit: 12 GPUs steady-state within 60 days
- Term: 12 months
- Discount: baseline list – 15%
- Ramp credits: $25k credit at MAP milestone "production ramp" (applies as invoice credit on first invoice post milestone).
- Burst: 15% free burst allowance first 90 days, then $0.22 / GPU-hour for on-demand overage.

Option B — Standard (24 mo, recommended)
- Commit: 20 GPUs steady-state by month 3
- Term: 24 months
- Discount: baseline list – 25%
- Ramp credits: $50k credit split — 50% at Po issuance, 50% at production ramp (applied as line-item credits).
- Burst: 25% free burst for first 120 days; extended burst priced at $0.18 / GPU-hour beyond allowance.

Option C — Enterprise (36 mo)
- Commit: 40 GPUs steady-state by month 6
- Term: 36 months
- Discount: baseline list – 32%
- Ramp credits: $120k credit applied 40/60 across Po and production ramp milestones; credits shown as invoice line items.
- Burst: configurable priority burst with guaranteed capacity reservations for planned launches (costed as committed short-term addendum).

Credit mechanics & legal notes:
- Credits are represented on the invoice as negative line items against the Dedicated service; they are not rebates or post-facto cash refunds.
- Credits require the MAP milestone checklist to be signed by both parties; we’ll include the checklist in the SOW.
- We can include a 30-day SLA exception clause for planned launch days (priority queueing) for Option B/C with a nominal fee.

DocuSign link for the Option B quote is included in the attached PDF and also at: https://www.docusign.net/Signing/?sId=ABCDEFG12345

If you want to preserve flexibility while giving procurement something that looks like a single Po, Option B is usually the fastest to close for customers with your forecast. Happy to hop on a short call to walk through numbers.
